call_points.text: Historically and on current OEM indications, H2 volumes are expected to be 20% higher than H1.
Extruded axle beam commercial output commenced, currently accounting for 80% of trailer axle output.
Company is investing ₹20-25 Cr in forward integration into cold drawn tubes for captive and merchant precision applications.
Receivable days dropped from over 110 days in H1 last year to around 90 days in H1FY27.
Steel and consumable cost increases are recurring quarterly, with price settlements lagging but compensated retrospectively.
M&HCV demand momentum continued, with Q3 and Q4 volumes expected to be stronger than Q2.
Exports contribute approximately 8% of total component business, with a commitment to increase the share.
Commercial vehicle demand remains robust with key OEMs reporting strong volume growth in Q4 continuing into April 2026.
Management targets increasing the tractor segment contribution to approximately 15% of total revenue over the next two years.
EBITDA margin is expected to remain between 14% to 15% for future quarters.

operating_notes.text: The company operates as a single segment (motor vehicle parts and accessories) and has no subsidiary, associate or joint venture as at March 31, 2026.
IPO proceeds of ₹2,369.19 million were fully utilised by March 31, 2026, with nil balance in the monitoring agency account.
The Jharkhand High Court quashed electricity duty on net charges on 5 January 2026; a ₹45.45 million refund is unrecognised pending finality.
Monitoring Agency Report for Q4 FY26 shows full utilisation of IPO proceeds with no deviation.
Q4FY26 trailer axles volume exceeded 10,500 units and air/mechanical suspensions exceeded 3,500 units.
Axle beam capacity stands at 7,500 units per month with commercial production commenced.
Extruded trailer axles started commercial rollout in August 2026, currently representing 80% of trailer axle output.
Largest customer contributes approximately 15% to 16% of total company revenue.
Cold drawn tube forward integration capex estimated at ₹20-25 Cr.

timeline.summary: Sudhir Rai, on behalf of Kross Limited’s promoters and persons acting in concert, declared no encumbrance on shares held as of March 31, 2026, with total promoter shareholding at 68.60%.

Kross Limited’s Senior Management, including **Sudhir Rai (Chairman & MD)**, **Sumeet Rai (WTD)**, and **Kunal Rai (WTD & CFO)**, will discuss Q4FY26 audited standalone results on **May 13, 2026, at 03:00 PM IST** via conference call.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹225.45 Cr (+21.9% YoY), net profit ₹22.45 Cr (+30.9% YoY).
Kross Limited filed its Monitoring Agency Report for Q4 FY26 confirming full utilisation of IPO proceeds.
Kross Limited’s Senior Management hosted an earnings conference call on May 13, 2026, discussing Q4FY26 and FY26 performance with investors and analysts.
Kross Limited reported Q4 FY26 standalone revenue of ₹225.45 Cr with net profit of ₹22.45 Cr during its earnings conference call on May 13, 2026.
India Ratings affirmed Kross's existing bank loan facilities at IND A/Stable and assigned ratings to additional limits of ₹179.5 million.
Kross Q2FY27 revenue rose 80% YoY to ₹235.1 Cr; PAT surged 144% to ₹19.7 Cr
Kross Limited reported Q2FY27 standalone revenue of ₹235.09 Cr with net profit of ₹19.69 Cr in its investor presentation.
Kross Limited’s Senior Management hosted an earnings conference call on October 19, 2026, discussing Q2FY27 and H1FY27 performance with an interactive Q&A session.
Held Q2FY27 concall; guided H2 volumes up 20% over H1, extruded trailer axles reaching 100% in H2, and seamless tube trials in Feb-Mar 2027.
Kross Limited approved the preferential allotment of 15 lakh equity shares and 15 lakh convertible warrants at ₹212 each, raising ₹63.6 Cr.
